constType:
∀ (fuel : ℕ) (p₁ p₂ : Grind.CommRing.Poly),

    match fuel with
    | 0 => p₁.concat p₂
    | fuel.succ =>
      match p₁, p₂ with
      | Grind.CommRing.Poly.num k₁, Grind.CommRing.Poly.num k₂ => Grind.CommRing.Poly.num (k₁ + k₂)
      | Grind.CommRing.Poly.num k₁, Grind.CommRing.Poly.add k₂ m₂ p₂ => (Grind.CommRing.Poly.add k₂ m₂ p₂).addConst k₁
      | Grind.CommRing.Poly.add k₁ m₁ p₁, Grind.CommRing.Poly.num k₂ => (Grind.CommRing.Poly.add k₁ m₁ p₁).addConst k₂
      | Grind.CommRing.Poly.add k₁ m₁ p₁, Grind.CommRing.Poly.add k₂ m₂ p₂ =>
        match m₁.grevlex m₂ with
        | Ordering.eq =>
          have k := k₁ + k₂;
          bif k == 0 then Grind.CommRing.Poly.combine.go fuel p₁ p₂
          else Grind.CommRing.Poly.add k m₁ (Grind.CommRing.Poly.combine.go fuel p₁ p₂)

          Grind.CommRing.Poly.add k₁ m₁ (Grind.CommRing.Poly.combine.go fuel p₁ (Grind.CommRing.Poly.add k₂ m₂ p₂))

          else
